seo_title: Decide where to go on holiday, together | somewhere🎉
seo_description: Can't decide where to go on holiday? somewhere🎉 lets the whole family add ideas, spread points in secret and let a fair draw pick your next trip. Free to use.

hero.heading: Can't agree where to go next? Let the draw decide.
hero.lead: somewhere🎉 keeps your family's holidays in one place: the trips you've been on, a map of where you've been, and a pool of ideas for where to go next. When it's time to decide where to go on holiday, everyone spreads their points in secret and the draw picks the winner.
perks: Share a link to invite the others

how.label: Departures · How it works
how.heading: From "where shall we go?" to booked, in four steps.

steps.title: Sign up and add the trips you've been on
steps.text: One of you signs up with an email and shares a link with everyone else. Each holiday becomes a ticket, and your map and passport fill in as you go.

steps.title: Put your ideas on standby
steps.text: Anyone in the family can add a place they'd love to go, with budget, travel time and type of trip.

steps.title: Everyone spreads their points
steps.text: You each share out your points in secret and get one veto. Nobody sees anyone else's until the draw.

steps.title: The draw picks where you go
steps.text: Every point is a ticket, so the more points an idea has, the better its chances. The departures board counts down to the one that gets a seat.

features.heading: Everything your family's holidays need, in one place
features.lead: Where you've been, where you want to go, and a fair way to choose between them.

been.title: Been
been.text: Every holiday you've had, as a ticket: where, when, how long, who came and how you got there.

places.title: Places
places.text: A map of everywhere you've been and everywhere you want to go, plus a passport that collects a stamp for each country.

next.title: Next
next.text: A shared pool of places to go next. Add the type of trip, the budget and the travel time so you can compare like for like.

draw.title: The draw
draw.text: Everyone spreads their points in secret, gets one veto, and the departures board reveals where you're going. Past draws are kept, so you can see how each one went.

why.heading: Picking a holiday shouldn't be the hard part

reasons.title: Everyone gets a say
reasons.text: Points are spread in secret, so the quietest voice counts as much as the loudest. And if there's somewhere you really can't face, that's what your veto is for.

reasons.title: No more going round in circles
reasons.text: Ideas stop getting lost in the group chat. They sit on standby until the draw, and once it's spun, the decision's made and you can get on with booking.

reasons.title: Remember everywhere you've been
reasons.text: Every trip fills in your map and passport, so years of family holidays live in one place, not across old photos and half-remembered dates.

signup.heading: Your next holiday is somewhere🎉. Find out where.
signup.lead: It's free. One of you signs up with an email, then shares a link so the rest of the family can join. No one else needs an account.
